query:
SELECT 
  j.id,
  j.competenceMonth,
  j.description,
  j.totalDebit,
  j.totalCredit,
  COUNT(ae.id) as qtd_entries
FROM journals j
LEFT JOIN accountingEntries ae ON j.id = ae.journalId
WHERE j.competenceMonth >= '2026-01'
GROUP BY j.id, j.competenceMonth, j.description, j.totalDebit, j.totalCredit
ORDER BY j.competenceMonth, j.description;
